learning_outcomes.text: Students will have comprehensive knowledge of the most important welding processes and their execution. They will know the corresponding investigation methods. They will know the design principles of welded constructions and have knowledge of welding seam design.

Students will have expanded their knowledge of welding technology experimentally, especially with regard to different welding processes and practical handling. The complex constructive design of a weld seam can be reliably estimated.

Students will be able to evaluate and analyze the influence of heat input during welding using microscopic means and materials testing methods. Furthermore, they will be able to select suitable welding processes and materials for a given load and design them for fatigue strength.

They will be able to identify and evaluate the properties of a weld seam and imperfections in a weld seam in accordance with standards, using targeted methods of materials testing and microscopy, as well as determine their cause and identify potential for improvement.

Students will be able to process the results obtained from practical experiments in a team and discuss them, taking into account the learned material and supplementary technical literature, and present them in an appropriate form.

syllabus_topics: Overview and presentation of the most important processes in the welding laboratory, process execution and testing of products
Investigation of weld seam and Heat Affected Zone (HAZ)
Microstructure determination considering CCT and Schaeffler diagrams
Assessment and calculation of welding safety
Weld seam design and joint shapes depending on the material, workpiece thickness, welding process and accessibility
Requirements for tolerances according to ISO 13920
Symbolic representation of welded joints according to ISO 2553
assessment_rules: The graded examination is an experimental work, corresponding to the scope of the laboratory activities (5 experiments). This module is a prerequisite for the examination to become a welding engineer.
bibliography: U. Reisgen, L. Stein, Grundlagen der Fügetechnik, DVS-Verlag, 2016.
K. J. Matthes, E. Richter, Schweißtechnik - Schweißen von metallischen Konstruktionswerkstoffen, Hansa-Verlag, 2021.
